title: Reusing Battle-tested Code: A Systematic Literature Review of Automated Software Transplantation
abstract: arXiv:2611.21630v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software reuse remains a fundamental challenge in software engineering, often caught between the security risks of external libraries and the reliability concerns of generative AI. Automated software transplantation offers a compelling alternative by enabling the direct extraction and integration, into new host systems, of battle-tested logic (code that has already survived the rigors of production, possibly over many years of extensive in-production use). This paper presents a systematic literature review to evaluate the current state-of-the-art and identify the remaining barriers preventing this technology from becoming a mainstream engineering practice. We identified 27 distinct automated software transplantation approaches. Our analysis reveals that while the adaptation of code is highly automated, significant bottlenecks remain in the manual prerequisite steps of organ location and test suite augmentation. translated_title: 重用久经考验的代码：自动化软件移植的系统性文献综述
translated_abstract: 软件重用仍然是软件工程中的一个根本性挑战，常常陷于外部库的安全风险与生成式AI的可靠性问题之间。自动化软件移植提供了一种引人注目的替代方案，它能够将久经考验的逻辑（即已在生产环境中经受住严苛考验、可能经过多年广泛实际使用验证的代码）直接提取并集成到新的宿主系统中。本文提出了一项系统性文献综述，以评估该技术的最新研究现状，并识别出阻碍其成为主流工程实践的剩余障碍。我们共识别出27种不同的自动化软件移植方法。我们的分析表明，尽管代码适配环节已高度自动化，但在器官定位和测试套件增强等人工前置步骤中仍存在显著瓶颈。最后，我们提出了一个研究议程。
tldr: 本文通过系统性文献综述评估了自动化软件移植领域的最新进展，识别出27种现有方法，发现尽管代码适配已高度自动化，但器官定位与测试套件增强等人工前置步骤仍是阻碍该技术走向主流工程实践的主要瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This systematic literature review of automated software transplantation identifies 27 existing approaches, revealing that while code adaptation is highly automated, the manual prerequisite steps of organ location and test suite augmentation remain the key barriers to mainstream adoption.
